name: Fēngshén Bǎng
summary: A Chinese RPG developed and published by C&E Inc. with the rights now owned by Super Fighter Team.

name: Fēngsè Huànxiǎng 4: Shèngzhàn de Zhōngyān
summary:
**This game is playable in Chinese only**

This installment of Fengse Huanxiang (Wind Fantasy) series is connected plot-wise to its predecessor, and is set in the same fantasy world and time line. The war between the countries of Ice and Fire devastated both those states, and Karin Seraphim, the white-haired leader of the special unit "Sin-Breaking Wings", found herself and her best friend in the opposite camps. Now, with the rulers of both countries dead, the war is finally over. However, there is a new disturbance in the Dragon Tomb. The Holy City of Nilu sends the priestess Niyi to investigate the matter. And when the young woman arrives at the tomb, she finds demons there... is this the beginning of a new war?

name: Fēngshén Yīngjié Zhuán
summary: Feng Shen Ying Jie Chuan is an unlicensed tactical-RPG released in 1996 for the Mega Drive, developed by Chuanpu. The game features a Wuxia setting, visually impressive effects and a set of very different characters.

name: Fēngsè Huànxiǎng II: Alive
summary:
**This game is playable in Chinese only**

Shuilan is a land that hovers above the ocean. Recently, a demon lord appeared nearby. The people of Shuilan know that the demon lord's plan is to invade and to conquer their country. The wise teacher Wentini builds a special unit of fighters, called the Fate Travel Group. She knows that the only one who can help the people of Shuilan is a girl with special powers, named Li Fu. She sends a young fighter named Ares to find Li Fu, but meanwhile Shuilan is invaded by a hostile army. The battles for survival begins...

name: Fēngshén Cè
summary: 《封神策》是一款可以自创修炼仙法的封神修仙题材动作游戏。你将扮演个性的仙门奇人，进入到殷商封神时期，帮助哪吒辅佐周文王周武王讨伐商纣，与妖邪斗智斗勇。在这里你可以自由修炼千百种仙法、道法、心法，组合仙法技能从而自创出一套属于你自己的特殊技能连招，华丽撼动天地的特效满屏释放！挑战神魔，收集神器都是小意思，你还能创立自己的仙门成为开山鼻祖，亦或是打遍全服玩家，成就神界霸主！

name: Fēng Shén Bǎng
summary:
Fēng Shén Bǎng is a 1996 one-on-one fighting game released for the Famicom throughout Asia. It was also released with a localized label as Myth Struggle, although the in-game content is unchanged. The game is based on the 16th century Chinese epic novel of the same name, also called Fēngshén Yǎnyì (封神演義) and often translated to Investiture of the Gods or The Creation of the Gods.
The game is essentially a hacked version of Hummer Team's earlier bootleg version of DragonBall Z: Super Butōden 2, which was originally released on the Super NES. The change by Waixing was made to legitimize the content as to not run into copyright laws, as this version was also released (although still unlicensed by Nintendo) in Japan and with likely intent to distribute outside of Asia.

name: Fēngshénbǎng 2020
summary: 本游戏以哪吒、小龙女、杨戬和姜太公为主角，讲述了主角们到各地冒险，最终到朝歌城灭三妖打败纣王的传奇故事。游戏包含哪吒闹海、地狱历险、四大恶人、魔家四将、救援西岐、梅山七怪、大战闻太师、进攻朝歌等章节。

name: Fēngsè Huànxiǎng III: Zuì Yǔ Fá de Zhènhúngē
